name: itecs-ncentral
description: Read-only N-central access through the official N-able hosted MCP service.

interface.shortDescription: Official N-able MCP, read-only N-central access
interface.longDescription: Connect to the official N-able hosted MCP service for N-central inventory, device metrics and reporting, including self-hosted N-central environments linked to your N-able SSO account. Requires an N-able API token supplied through the host environment.
defaultPrompt: Look up N-central device inventory and health for this client.
